summary: Backend: 11/11 pytest tests PASS covering health, locations/tags/borrowers CRUD, tool create with photos+documents, list+filters (search/location_id/tag_id/checked_out), update, checkout (incl. 400 on double-checkout), checkin (incl. 400 when not out + history append), stats and delete-then-404. No _id leaked in any response. Frontend (mobile 390x844): app loads, TOOLBOX header + search + filter chips + FAB render. Bottom tab navigation works (clicked via coordinates because tab buttons have no testIDs). Settings tab: add/delete Location and Tag works (testIDs add-location-btn / del-location-{id} / add-tag-btn / del-tag-{id}). People tab: add Borrower via add-borrower-fab works (UI_Mike persisted). Reports tab: stat grid + report cards render (AVAILABLE / CHECKED OUT labels visible). Add Tool flow: FAB opens new-tool screen, name-input/cost-input/pick-loc-{id}/pick-tag-{id}/save-tool-btn all function -> tool appears in inventory list with correct location & tag chips and IN status. Tool detail / checkout / checkin UI flow could NOT be auto-tested because tool list cards do not expose a testID (no tool-card-{id}), so tap-to-detail navigation could not be selected reliably. Backend already validates these flows.

ui_bugs.issue: Tab bar buttons have no testID (e.g. tab-inventory, tab-people, tab-reports, tab-settings). Had to fall back to coordinate clicks for automated testing.
Each tool row in the list lacks a testID like tool-card-{id}. Blocks reliable automated navigation to the tool detail / checkout / checkin screens.

issues: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow), props.pointerEvents is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking but should be migrated.

react_native_issues.issue: Expo doctor warns: expo-sharing@55.0.18 vs expected ~14.0.8. Not blocking web preview but may break native build.

action_items: Add testID to bottom tab bar buttons: tab-inventory, tab-people, tab-reports, tab-settings.
Add testID="tool-card-{tool.id}" on each tool list row (TouchableOpacity/Pressable) in app/(tabs)/index.tsx so detail navigation, checkout & checkin flows can be UI-verified.
(Optional) Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow and props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents to silence RN web deprecation warnings.
(Optional) Reconcile expo-sharing version with the expected ~14.0.8 from expo-doctor.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is concise (<400 lines) and already excludes _id at the projection layer ({"_id": 0}) plus a clean() helper. Pydantic models cover all create/update/checkout payloads. HTTP codes 400 (already-out / not-out) and 404 (missing tool) are correct.
All env vars (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL) are read without defaults — fails fast on missing config. Good.
Tool history append on checkin mutates a list read from Mongo and writes it back atomically with one $set; acceptable for single-user app but not concurrency-safe (consider $push).

success_rate.frontend: ~80% (detail/checkout/checkin UI not exercised due to missing testIDs; APIs validated)

seed_data_creation: Test pytest creates and cleans TEST_-prefixed Location/Tag/Borrower/Tool. UI test left a 'Garage' location, 'Power' tag, 'Mike' & 'UI_Mike' borrowers and 'UI_Hammer' tool in the DB — main agent may keep or wipe.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bottom tabs have no testIDs and tool list cards have no testID — use coordinate clicks for tabs (y~810; INVENTORY x~48, PEOPLE x~146, REPORTS x~244, SETTINGS x~341) or ask main agent to add testIDs first. Detail screen testIDs (when reachable): checkout-btn, checkin-btn, seg-free, seg-list, freetext-name, confirm-checkout-btn, confirm-checkin-btn (verify these exist after main agent adds card testID). Backend BASE = EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env, currently https://toolbox-vault-v3.preview.emergentagent.com.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Only test-instrumentation gaps (missing testIDs) blocked full UI coverage of the checkout/checkin path, but backend tests confirm those endpoints behave correctly including 400 edge cases and history persistence.
